resources.string: Faka idethi ye-Hijri ukuze uthole i-Arafah, i-An-Nahr nezinsuku ze-Tashreeq
Faka idethi ye-Hijri ukuze ubone i-Arafah, i-An-Nahr nezinsuku ze-Tashreeq
Faka idethi evumelekile ye-Hijri. Unyaka kusuka ku-1300 kuya ku-1600, inyanga ukusuka ku-1 kuye ku-12, usuku ukusuka ku-1 kuye ku-30.

Faka noma yiluphi usuku lwe-Hijri (noma ugcine usuku lwamanje) ukuze uthole ngokushesha izinsuku ze-Hajj zonyaka wayo: uSuku lwe-Arafah (9 Dhul-Hijjah), uSuku lwe-An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjah) kanye nezinsuku ze-Tashreeq (11, 12 kanye no-13 Dhul-Hijjah), ngalunye oluhambisana nosuku lwalo olulinganayo kanye ne-Gregorian yakho.
Insika enkulu kunazo zonke: yima e-Arafah kusukela emini kuze kube kushona ilanga, yenza ukunxusa okuningi, i-takbir ne-tahlil. Wathi uMprofethi: "IHajj yi-Arafah."
I-Eid al-Adha: itshe i-Jamarat al-Aqabah elinamatshe ayisikhombisa, linikele ngomhlatshelo, liphuce noma liphungule, bese lenza i-Tawaf al-Ifadah ne-Sai.
Isaziso sansuku zonke esikukhumbuza ngomkhosi ohlosiwe ngesikhathi sawo phakathi nezinsuku zeHajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)
Isaziso sansuku zonke esikukhumbuza ngomkhosi ohlosiwe ngesikhathi sawo phakathi nezinsuku zeHajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)
I-sunnah yalolu suku: ngena e-ihram, uye e-Mina futhi uchithe ubusuku lapho, uphinda i-Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", futhi uthandaze lapho ufinyezwe ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa.
Jikela ama-Jamarat amathathu emva kwemini: encane, bese emaphakathi, bese kuba amakhulu, amatshe ayisikhombisa ngalinye kuyilapho ethi takbir, enxusa ngemva kwamancane naphakathi.
Phinda ushaye ama-Jamarat amathathu ntambama njengayizolo. Noma ubani ofisa ukushesha makahambe eMina lingakashoni ilanga; ohleziyo uchitha ubusuku, akhande ngamatshe ngosuku lwesithathu.
Jikijela i-Jamarat emithathu ngemva kwemini, bese uphetha iHajj ngokuvalelisa i-Tawaf lapho usuka eMakkah. Kwangathi uAllah Angamukela iHajj yakho.

Ireferensi ephelele yeHajj kanye ne-Umrah: incazelo nezinqumo, izinhlobo zemicikilisho, i-mawaqit, imicikilisho isinyathelo ngesinyathelo ngobuhlakani bayo nokuthi yini okufanele ithini esiteshini ngasinye, ukwenqatshelwa kwe-ihram, kanye nokunxusa. Khetha isigaba ofisa ukusihlola.
Amagama abo, ama-sunnah, nalokho okufanele umlaleli akusho
Imithetho yokuzila ukudla, izethulo zakho namasunnah
Kusukela ekuvakasheleni abagulayo ukuya ekuwashweni, ukungcwatshwa kanye nenduduzo
Umhlahlandlela ophelele: amasiko isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, ukuhlakanipha kwawo, kanye nokunxusa
Amagama angamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye nesishiyagalolunye nezincazelo zawo
Yini ephula ukungcola nomthandazo, futhi yini engenzi
Ukukholelwa kuAllah, izingelosi zaKhe, izincwadi, izithunywa, uSuku Lokugcina kanye nomthetho kaNkulunkulu
Izinsika ezinhlanu okwakhiwe phezu kwazo inkolo
Imithandazo yokuzithandela eqinisekisiwe ngaphambi nangemva kwesibopho
Umthandazo isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, ukusuka ku-takbir kuya ku-taslim
Isiqalo nesiphetho somthandazo ngamunye kwemihlanu yansuku zonke
Izimo zayo, i-nisab kanye nezigaba eziyisishiyagalombili zabamukeli

UmProfethi (ukuthula kube kuye) wathi: “UAllah unamagama angamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye nesishiyagalolunye, ikhulu ngaphansi nelilodwa; noma ubani owabalayo uzongena ePharadesi. Thepha noma yiliphi igama ukuze ufunde incazelo yalo ephelele, incazelo kanye nobufakazi obuvela kuQuran.
